note: MetaMask test from the production app (fieldcall-bars26.vercel.app) on Bradbury testnet, contract 0xA6280Ed66eF5Ea243DEC2236441Be0588EAFEb0f, five validators per transaction. The tester opens a call from the "Asian hornet nests, UK" preset with "Also check GBIF" ticked and 1 GEN of funding: the app first deposits the GEN, then opens the call, which sends none. A submission to that photo call ended without a majority (Bradbury validators often run out of time on image prompts, as the README says; the contract state did not change), so the tester submitted the same real observation to the demo's GBIF call without a photo condition, which all five validators ruled eligible. The rest exercises the credit path: a refused top-up is credited back and withdrawn, and the eligible sighting is settled once its response window has passed.
steps: Deposit 1 GEN (sent by the app before opening the call)
Open a call: Asian hornet nests, UK, GBIF required, funded with 1 GEN from the deposit
call_1 open; validators read taxon 119019 and place 6857 from iNaturalist; 5/5
Submit observation 397236811 to the photo call
no majority (two validators disagreed on the photo reading, one timed out): no sighting stored, the pot untouched
Collect the reward of the demo's sighting_0
refused in code, 5/5: the observer has no wallet in their iNaturalist profile, so nobody can collect it yet
Submit observation 397236811 to call_0 (GBIF required, no photo condition)
sighting_2 ELIGIBLE, 5/5: Vespa velutina, research grade, Romsey 2026-08-18, inside the UK; GBIF occurrence 6519102855 has the same species and date; reward held for the observer
Add 0.05 GEN to call_1 (below the 0.1 GEN minimum)
REFUNDED: credited back to the tester, 5/5; totals() owed 0.05 GEN, contract balance matched
0.05 GEN sent to the tester, 5/5; credit back to 0
settled, 5/5: awaiting_wallet, 0.5 GEN held for the observer
